ceilingNote: Declension class is NOT a DCS tag. DCS annotates case, number and gender; it never annotates a declension class, so every class label in this asset is an orthographic heuristic over the lemma's citation form and inherits Sangram G2's §6.1 caveat that the citation form is not the stem. Known pooled conflations are labelled per class and never split by guesswork: -ī pools the devī type with the monosyllabic śrī type; -an pools -an/-man/-van; -ant pools -ant/-vant/-mant with the master's own -at/-vat/-mat citation variants of the same stems; other_consonant is a residue bucket, not a class. Compound members (feat_case='Cpd', ~32% of all NOUN/ADJ tokens) carry no case and are excluded from the 24-cell grid, counted separately per class. Endings are surface residues after stripping the class-marked stem prefix, not morphological segmentations; tokens whose form does not start with that stem (strong/weak alternation, rājan -> rājñā) are counted as not segmentable and excluded from the endings view rather than force-split. The form displayed is DCS's unsandhied analysis, which for ~68% of cased NOUN/ADJ tokens is flagged reconstructed rather than directly attested surface text. Finally, the gender axis is the TOKEN's tagged gender, not the lemma's lexical gender: an adjective cited in its masculine -a form contributes its feminine tokens (paramayā) to the -a class's Fem column, where they inflect as ā-/ī-stems -- so a gender column of a class is 'tokens of this class tagged with this gender', never 'the class's paradigm in this gender'.
classHeuristicNote: class = first match of the lemma's citation form against the G2 lemma-final tag list, extended with -ant; NOT a corpus tag and NOT a paradigmatic classification

strīṇāṃ nigṛhyamāṇānāṃ kopiteṣu mahātmasu
dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau
sā mitho 'hamahamikā yā tu saṃbhāvanātmani
akīrtiḥ pātitā mūrdhni kauśalyāṃ sa praśasya ca
pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhasa ity aindre niṣkevalye nividaṃ dadhāti pratyakṣāddhyeva tad ātman vīryaṃ dhatte
kau bhavantau mahātmānau parasparahitaiṣiṇau
minantā dasyor aśivasya māyā anupūrvaṃ vṛṣaṇā codayantā
tāvubhau śubhakarmāṇau stutau vidyāviśāradau

sthite marutvatīye hotā visaṃsthita saṃcareṇa niṣkramya āgnīdhrīye tisraḥ ājya āhutīḥ juhoti audumbareṇa sruveṇa anu mām indraḥ anu mām bṛhaspatiḥ anu somaḥ anu vāc devī āvīt anu mām mitrāvaruṇau iha āvatām anu dyāvāpṛt…
varṇayanti mahātmānaḥ śrutenārthena cāñjasā
manaḥśṛṅgārasaṃkalpātmāno yoniḥ suhṛnmadhuḥ
rājā niśo ratnakarau ca candraḥ somo 'mṛtaśvetahimadyutir glauḥ
yathaivātmā tathā vajraṃ tasmān maulyaṃ samarpayet
brahmā yakṣeṭ kumāraḥ ṣaṇmukhapātālakiṃnarāḥ

upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenum etāṃ hiṃkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnām abhi tvā deva savitaḥ sam ī vatsaṃ na mātṛbhiḥ saṃ vatsa iva mātṛbhir yas te stanaḥ śaśayo yo mayobhūr gaur amīmed anu vatsam miṣantaṃ namased upa sīdata saṃjā…
ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāv ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
tathā rājānā karatho yad īmaha ṛtāvānā yad īmahe

ṛṇam asmin saṃnayati amṛta tvam ca gacchati pitā putrasya jātasya paśyet ced jīvataḥ mukham yāvantaḥ pṛthivyām bhogāḥ yāvantaḥ jātavedasi yāvantaḥ apsu prāṇinām bhūyān putre pituḥ tatas śaśvat putreṇa pitaraḥ atyāyan ba…
so 'rdharce yājyāyai vasāhomaṃ juhoti ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapāvānaḥ pibata vasāṃ vasāpāvānaḥ pibata antarikṣasya havir asi svāhā tvāntarikṣāya svāheti
śṛṇota grāvāṇo viduṣo nu yajñaṃ śṛṇotu devaḥ savitā havaṃ me svāheti
mayi muktim ite rājan gautamākhyaḥ sudharmavāk
tam saṃbhṛtya āhatuḥ brahman pravargyeṇa pracariṣyāmaḥ hotar abhiṣṭuhi iti
teṣām ha uttiṣṭhatām uvāca api nu rājan itthaṃvidam vedeḥ utthāpayanti iti
pṛthivītvaṃ sajātīyāt salilādeḥ pṛthivyā viśeṣo dṛṣṭaḥ asajātīyābhyāṃ ca guṇakarmabhyām
tataḥ sa tebhyo dharmavyasanasaṃvartanīyebhyaḥ karmabhyo vinivṛtya puṇyābhisaṃskārameva kuryāt jīvitahetor api saddharmaṃ na pratikṣepsyati mā bhūdasmākam api tādṛśair duḥkhaiḥ samavadhānamiti
lombhyaḥ oṣadhi vanaspatayaḥ
so 'trā lomabhya ā nakhebhyaḥ sarvaḥ sāṅga āpyate tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāny ā pipīlikābhya āptāny eva jāyante
pādā bhaṭṭārako devaḥ prayojyāḥ pūjyanāmataḥ
asterjñānātsatyāttadātmanaḥ karmaṇaśca param
amṛtāt iva janmanaḥ iti amṛta tvam eva asmin tat dadhāti
athāṃsayoḥ samāsajya natayor asicarmaṇī
dve nāmanī kuryāt
añjite vartmanī kiṃcic cālayeccaivam añjanam
te vapām eva hutvā an ādṛtya itarāṇi karmāṇi ūrdhvāḥ svargam lokam āyan
yad vāvāna purutamam purāṣāﾱ ā vṛtrahendro nāmāny aprāḥ aceti prāsahas patis tuviṣmān iti
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni nirmame yajñasiddhaye
narakārhaṃ karma cakrurgrahīṣyantyadhamādapi
dvaividhyaṃ brahma vakṣyāmi śṛṇu vyāsākhilānugam
tad iti vā etasya mahato bhūtasya nāma bhavati yo 'syaitad evaṃ nāma veda brahma bhavati brahma bhavati
saḥ asya ayam ātmā puṇyebhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ pratidhīyate
lomabhyaḥ svāheti ca vā lomaprabhṛti vai tanum
dhāmāsi dhāmyai tvā dhāmabhyas tvā dhāmasu sīda
śrotreṇa sṛṣṭā diśaś ca candramāś ca digbhyo hainam āyantī3ṃ digbhyo viśṛṇoti candramā asmai pūrvapakṣāparapakṣān vicinoti puṇyāya karmaṇa evam ete śrotraṃ pitaraṃ paricaranti diśaś ca candramāś ca
ime tu eva juhuyāt brahma prapadye brahma mā kṣatrāt gopāyatu brahmaṇe svāhā iti
atha enat yathāhṛtam pratiparyāhṛtya uttara ardhe vedyai nidhāya adhvaryuḥ avekṣate agneḥ jihvā asi subhūḥ devānām dhāmne dhāmne devebhyaḥ yajuṣe yajuṣe bhava iti
balābalaviśeṣo'sti tayorapi ca karmaṇoḥ
upānadyuganāśaśca prapātaḥ pādacarmaṇoḥ
agniṣṭomasāmasaṃdhiṣāmnor evāpṛṣṭhaṃ stobhed iti śāṇḍilyaḥ
pradīpaḥ sarvavidyānām upāyaḥ sarvakarmaṇām

sa mahān bhūtvā devatā abravīd uddhāram ma uddharateti yathāpy etarhīcchati yo vai bhavati yaḥ śreṣṭhatām aśnute sa mahān bhavati taṃ devā abruvan svayam eva brūṣva yat te bhaviṣyatīti sa etam māhendraṃ graham abrūta mā…
rūḍhayaugikamiśrāṇāṃ nāmnāṃ mālāṃ tanomyaham
pathyāpathyam atho vipākam akhilaṃ tāvan nṛṇāṃ karmaṇaḥ
yat sarped ṛcam eva tat sāmno 'nuvartmānaṃ kuryād ya enaṃ tatra brūyād anuvartmā nvā ayaṃ hotā sāmagasyābhūd udgātari yaśo'dhād acyoṣṭāyatanāc cyoṣyata āyatanād iti śaśvat tathā syāt
yad v eva hiṅkāreṇa pratipadyatā3i yathā vā abhrir evaṃ brahmaṇo hiṅkāro yad vai kiñcābhriyābhititṛtsaty abhy evaitat tṛṇatty evam
mantrī caiṣāṃ vṛttikarmabhyāṃ viyateta
ṛksāmābhyām abhihitau gāvau te sāmanāv aitām
dambhachadmabhyāṃ paraistarkitāya dīyate pratipadya vā sa āsuraḥ
munibhiḥ pṛṣṭavān devaṃ pūjitaṃ jñānakarmabhiḥ
vividhair nāmabhiḥ krūro nānāyoniṣu vartate
tasya vāk tantir nāmāni dāmāni tad asyedaṃ vācā tantyā nāmabhir dāmabhiḥ sarvaṃ sitaṃ sarvaṃ hīdaṃ nāmānī3ṃ sarvaṃ vācābhivadati

sa ya enaṃ śaste tūṣṇīṃśaṃsa upa vā vaded anu vā vyāharet tam brūyād eṣa evaitām ārtim āriṣyati prātar vāva vayam adyemaṃ śaste tūṣṇīṃśaṃse saṃsthāpayāmas taṃ yathā gṛhān itaṃ karmaṇānusamiyād evam evainam idam anusamim…
bilve dve 'pi mānika ca prasṛtaṃ nāmnā caturbhiḥ palaiḥ yuktaḥ syāt kuḍavo 'ñjaliś ca palikāny aṣṭau śarāvo bhavet
brahmaṇā eva tat vācam saṃdadhāti
udupadhād bhāvādikarmaṇor anyatarasyām
ghṛtasya niścalaṃ mūrdhni vartmanośca viśeṣataḥ
śvabhraśmaśānaśayanaṃ patanaṃ pāṃsubhasmanoḥ
navāny anyāni yojyāni dravyāṇy akhilakarmasu
bali homa svastivācanaiḥ parvasu ca agni pūjāḥ kārayet
vrīhivaktrā dhanurvakrā pakvāmāśayamarmasu
viśuddho jāyate sūtaḥ tataḥ karmaṇi yajayet
sāmānyam vaiśyavarṇe ca adhamaṃ śūdrajanmani

yo mahatyarthasamudaye sthitaḥ kadaryaḥ saṃnidhatte 'vanidhatte 'vasrāvayati vā saṃnidhatte svaveśmani avanidhatte paurajānapadeṣu avasrāvayati paraviṣaye tasya sattrī mantrimitrabhṛtyabandhupakṣam āgatiṃ gatiṃ ca dravy…
bṛhadrathaṃtare sāmanī bhavata ete vai yajñasya nāvau sampāriṇyau yad bṛhadrathaṃtare tābhyām eva tat saṃvatsaraṃ taranti
syāt saṃdeśaharo dūto dūtyaṃ tadbhāvakarmaṇī
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat
kṣepaṇo guṇaḥ kṣudrakam iti karmāṇi
etāṇi sūtanāmāni sarvarogeṣu yojayet

bṛhac ca te rathaṃtaraṃ ca pūrvau pādau bhavatāṃ vairūpaṃ ca vairājaṃ cāparau śākvararaivate śīrṣaṇye naudhasaṃ ca kāleyaṃ cānūcye ṛcaḥ prācīnātānāḥ sāmāni tiraścīnavāyā yajūṃṣy atīkāśā yaśa āstaraṇaṃ śrīr upabarhaṇaṃ s…
eṣa panthaitat karmaitad brahmaitat satyam
śivaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ śreyo nirvāṇaṃ brahma nirvṛtiḥ
kṣiptāgnau bhasma na syāc cimicimi kurute carmagandhā hutāśe
uto hi vām pūrvyā āvividra ṛtāvarī rodasī satyavācaḥ
brahma prajām me dhukṣva
amṛta vyoma sanātana sadasadvyaktāvyakta ṛtadhāman pūrvādideva vasuprada prajāpate suprajāpate vanaspate
lokadhāma jagannātha lokānām abhayaprada
pūṣā tu yajamānasya dadbhir jakṣatu piṣṭabhuk
nāśaṃ naśan svayaṃ srasann asatībhyo asattarāḥ
kavatībhyo hy eti prājāpatyābhyaḥ
saṃsthā stha saṃsthā vo bhūyāsthācyutā stha mā mā cyoḍhvaṃ māhaṃ bhavatībhyaś cauṣīḥ
ā indra yāhi upa naḥ parāvataḥ indrāya hi dyauḥ asuraḥ anamnata pra u su asmai puroratham iti atas anurūpaḥ
atha yājyā parasyā adhi saṃvato 'varaṃ abhy ā tara yatrāham asmi taṃ aveti
arvāvato na ā gahy atho śakra parāvataḥ
te rasavatyā upajīvanīye imāḥ prajā upajīvanti
pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī namobhiḥ sabādha īﾱe bṛhatī yajatre
abhyahārayatāṃ kruddhau pragṛhya mahatī gade
yena devā amṛtam anvavindan yenauṣadhīr madhumatīr akṛṇvan
yaḥ prathamaḥ pravata āsasāda bahubhyaḥ panthām anupaspaśānaḥ

indro vai vṛtraṃ hatvā nāstṛṣīti manyamānaḥ parāḥ parāvato 'gacchat sa paramām eva parāvatam agacchad anuṣṭub vai paramā parāvad vāg vā anuṣṭup sa vācam praviśyāśayat taṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni vibhajyānvaicchaṃs tam pūrvedyuḥ…
saṃdhāṃ mahatīṃ rakṣata yayāgre asurā jitāḥ

yo vai gāyatrīṃ pakṣiṇīṃ cakṣuṣmatīṃ jyotiṣmatīm bhāsvatīṃ veda gāyatryā pakṣiṇyā cakṣuṣmatyā jyotiṣmatyā bhāsvatyā svargaṃ lokam ety eṣā vai gāyatrī pakṣiṇī cakṣuṣmatī jyotiṣmatī bhāsvatī yad dvādaśāhas tasya yāv abhit…
sa bṛhatīm diśam anuvyacalat
yato na punar āyasi śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ
evam aparāsu strībhyo dadyān majjavarjaṃ surāṃ tūpaninīya manthenābhitaḥ pariṣicya ye cātra rasāḥ syur etad bhavatībhya ity uktvā tṛpyantu bhavatya ity uktvā
ṣaḍbhya sma haritmatībhyo meta
bhavatyai rocate neti mātar ākhyāyatām iti
yat asyai vācaḥ bṛhatyai patiḥ tasmāt bṛhaspatiḥ
bhadravatyai subhadrāyai dhanaugham upajahratuḥ
smarati ca bhavatyoḥ
mahatyāḥ pañcamūlyāstu bṛhatyoścaikaśaḥ pṛthak
viśo viśa īḍyam adhvareṣv adṛptakratum aratiṃ yuvatyoḥ
upāyam anyaṃ patayo bhavatīnāṃ na jānate
drapso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnām indro munīnāṃ sakhā svāhā
barhiṣī antardhāya dadhi ānayati ṛdhyāsam adya pṛṣatīnām graham pṛṣatīnām grahaḥ asi iti
yadi vrajiṣyasy atihāya madvaco bhadraṃ bhavatyā na tato bhaviṣyati
namas te pravato napād yatas tapaḥ samūhase
tacca rājann apaśyantyāḥ kā śāntir hṛdayasya me
athodaṅṅ atyākramya yathāyatanaṃ srucau sādayitvā vājavatībhyāṃ srucau vyūhati vājasya mā prasavena udgrābheṇodagrabhīditi
manasvatībhyāṃ juhoti
apasyavatībhyāṃ śāntyai
yavamatībhiḥ prokṣaṇībhiḥ yūpam prokṣati pṛthivyai tvā iti mūlam antarikṣāya tvā iti madhyam dive tvā iti agram
tāḥ ubhayīḥ ānīyamānāḥ pratimantrayate sam āpaḥ adbhiḥ agmata sam oṣadhayaḥ rasena sam revatīḥ jagatībhiḥ madhumatīḥ madhumatībhiḥ sṛjyadhvam iti
abhāṣata tato lakṣmīrbhavatībhiranādarāt
tatas tena sārthavāhena bhāgīrathaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ dvāṣaṣṭyarhatsahasraparivṛto mahatyā vibhūtyā nausaṃkrameṇottāritaḥ

tato bālacandrikā tayorantaraṅgavṛttiṃ bhāvavivekairjñātvā kāntāsamājasannidhau rājanandanodantasya samyagākhyānamanucitamiti lokasādhāraṇairvākyairabhāṣata bhartṛdārike ayaṃ sakalakalāpravīṇo devatāsānnidhyakaraṇa āhav…
arvāg vāmasya pravatā ni yacchathas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
tad yaddharivatīṣu stuvanti taddhy eva jyaiṣṭhyam
prātaḥsavanāc cet kalaśo vidīryeta vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu tṛcā stūyuḥ
yat kavatīṣu stuvanti tena prājāpatyam
paramasyāṃ parāvati śuṣko bhaṇḍuś ca tiṣṭhataḥ
mahaujaso mānadhanā dhanārcitā dhanurbhṛtaḥ saṃyati labdhakīrtayaḥ
yat adya sthaḥ parāvati yat arvāvati aśvinā yat vā purū puru bhujā yat antarikṣe ā gatam
dyāvā pṛthivī payasā payasvatī ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām
sahasradhā pañcadaśāny uktheti pañca hi daśato bhavanti yāvad dyāvāpṛthivī tāvad it tad iti yāvatī vai dyāvāpṛthivī tāvān ātmā
divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne
revatīr naḥ sadhamāda iti tisraḥ

te haike sapta saptānvāhuḥ sapta prātaḥsavane sapta mādhyaṃdine sapta tṛtīyasavane yāvatyo vai puronuvākyās tāvatyo yājyāḥ sapta vai prāñco yajanti sapta vaṣaṭkurvanti tāsām etāḥ puronuvākyā iti vadantaḥ
madhumatīḥ oṣadhayaḥ āpaḥ madhumatīḥ uta
yā mahatī mahonmānā viśvā āśā vyānaśe
te viduḥ iyān vāva kila paśuḥ yāvatī vapā iti
atha duḥṣamaikaviṃśatirabdasahasrāṇi tāvatī tu syāt
ūrjam asmā ūrjasvatī dhattaṃ payo 'smai payasvatī dhattam
ūrjam asmā ūrjasvatī dhattaṃ payo 'smai payasvatī dhattam
revatīr anādhṛṣṭāḥ siṣāsantīḥ siṣāsatha
devīr dvāro bṛhatīr viśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ
devīr āpo madhumatīḥ saṃsṛjyadhvaṃ mahi kṣatraṃ kṣatriyāya vanvānā iti
sarasvati predam ava subhage vājinīvati
bhavati bhikṣāṃ dehīti brāhmaṇo bhikṣeta
athāsau kathañcitkṣaṇamadhomukhī dhyātvā dīrghoṣṇaśvāsapūrvamavocat bhagavati patirekadaivataṃ vanitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ kulajānām
ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ prapadābhyām
veśantahimavadbhyām aṇ
kumahadbhyām anyatarasyām
gandharvāṇāṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ bhavadbhyaḥ śatapañcakam
asadbhyastu samādadyāt sadbhyaḥ saṃpratipādayet
dadbhir anyatodadbhyo bhūyāṃ lomabhir ubhayādadbhyaḥ
amuñcaṃ tvā vaiśvānarād arṇavān mahatas pari
sarvatrendrakratuṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinordhvaṃ viṣuvataḥ prāg atirātrāt
rajaḥpradhānān mahatas triliṅgo daivacoditāt
aṣṭhīvantāv abravīn mitro mamaitau kevalāv iti
ṛṣvā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upastheyāma śaraṇā bṛhantā
atha yat prayājānuyājebhyo barhiṣmantāv uddharati prajā vai barhir net prajāṃ pitṛṣu dadhānīti
mā no hiṃsīr mahato mā hiṃsīr mahyas tvam
sa tāṃstāvataḥ sattvān parinirvāpayati
yad dyāva indra te śataṃ yad indra yāvatas tvam iti vairūpam pṛṣṭham bhavati rāthaṃtare 'hani tṛtīye 'hani tṛtīyasyāhno rūpam

tataḥ śaraṇam abhiruhya rājagṛhābhimukhaḥ sthitvā ubhau jānumaṇḍale pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya puṣpāṇi kṣipan dhūpam udakaṃ ca bhagavantam āyācituṃ pravṛttaḥ āgacchatu bhagavān yajñaṃ me anubhavituṃ yajñavāṭam iti
ātmānaṃ cānuśocāmi bhavantaṃ cāmarottamam
indrāgnī tvā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānāv āyuṣmantam uttamaṃ tvā karātaḥ
priyaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ kṛtavān satyenātmānamālabhe
uto pitṛbhyām pravidānu ghoṣam maho mahadbhyām anayanta śūṣam
so 'haṃ bhavadbhya upalabdhasutīrthakīrtiś chindyāṃ svabāhum api vaḥ pratikūlavṛttim
namaḥ sakhibhyaḥ pūrvasadbhyo namo 'parasadbhyo bhūr bhuvaḥ svar bṛhaspatibrahmāhaṃ mānuṣa om ity uktvaudumbarīṃ gatvopaviśet
sa etam ādityebhyo bhuvadvadbhyaś caruṃ niravapat
līlānāṭyakṛte bhuvo bhagavate kṛṣṇāya tubhyaṃ namaḥ
saḥ agnaye marutvate trayodaśa kapālam puroﾱāśam nirvapet
kriyatāṃ nādhunā yuddhaṃ svasti pārthāya dhīmate
bhrātṛvye bhavator jāte bhrātur āgamane 'thavā
āhaṃ sarasvatīvator ity achāvākasya vāg vai sarasvatī vāgvator iti haitad āhendrāgnyor avo vṛṇa ity etaddha vā indrāgnyoḥ priyaṃ dhāma yad vāg iti priyeṇaivainau tad dhāmnā samardhayati
antare duṣkaraṃ sthātuṃ meṣayor mahator iva
yathā hyaśrotriyaḥ śrāddhaṃ na satāṃ bhoktum arhati
sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ manye bhavatāṃ ca yadapriyam
mahatāṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ mūlavalkaṃ pradāpayet

aho paradaśā kvāpi vartate muktacetasaḥ
āsiñca sarpir ghṛtavat samaṅgdhy eṣa bhāgo aṅgiraso no atra
yudhāmanyūttamaujobhyāṃ saubhadreṇa ca dhīmatā

śruteś ca vidvadbhir upākṛtāyāṃ kathāsudhāyām upasaṃprayogam

yat kṣureṇa marcayatā sutejasā vaptā vapasi keśaśmaśru

tannirvṛttir viśeṣaś ca vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā
nasoḥ adhi pramandanam

etadas tratasos tratasau ca anudāttau

yathā yaśaś candramasy āditye ca nṛcakṣasi

prakṣālitopavātāny akliṣṭāni vāsāṃsi patnīyajamānāv ṛtvijaś ca paridadhīran

chandobhyaḥ svāhā

rakṣobhyas tveti
